column_description: Unique identifier for each cache type.
Name of the cache. may be NULL.
Type of the cache (e.g., in-memory, distributed, file-based). always exactly one of 'in-memory', 'distributed', 'file-based'. may be NULL.
Description of the cache. may be NULL.
Indicates if the cache supports read-only access. may be NULL.
Indicates if the cache supports nonstrict-read-write access. may be NULL.
Indicates if the cache supports read-write access. may be NULL.
Indicates if the cache supports transactional access. may be NULL.
Maximum size of the cache in bytes. may be NULL.
Policy for evicting items from the cache (e.g., LRU, FIFO). always exactly one of 'LRU', 'FIFO'. may be NULL.
Time-to-live for cache entries in seconds. may be NULL.
Indicates if the cache is distributed. may be NULL.
Version of the cache implementation. may be NULL.
